outcomes.question: 1Q Spread: Texans (-7.5)

raw_market.question: 1Q Spread: Texans (-7.5)
raw_market.description:
In the first quarter of the NFL game between Texans and Titans, scheduled for October 11 at 1:00 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Texans" if the Texans outscore the Titans by 8 or more points in the first quarter.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Titans".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.

outcomes.price_history_cleaning: Reject invalid/future points and conflicting timestamps; deduplicate identical points. Flag large jumps without smoothing.
